reviews.scope: elo-ladder / elo-promotion feature set (commits 7b53e5d..9450e38 plus follow-ups 924f6be, df794b3, 06e6129, bde4f9b)

findings.summary: Test uses ..EvaluationConfig::default() which inherits the new checkpoints_dir=PathBuf::from("checkpoints") field; with no .with_opponent(...), a leftover ./checkpoints/best_v*.pt from a prior selfplay run drops execution into the Elo-gate fallback branch (evaluation.rs:341-376) that logs a WARN and continues, skipping the promotion-gate at 530-557. The final assert_eq!(store_ref.version(), 5, ...) then fails.
findings.repro: cargo test test_evaluation_task_promotes_when_threshold_zero in a workspace where ./checkpoints/best_v001.pt exists
findings.fix_sketch: Point checkpoints_dir at a tmpdir like sibling tests bootstrap_path_uses_win_rate_gate (638) and bootstrap_path_blocks_when_threshold_unreachable (692), or wire .with_opponent(...) to populate opponent_evaluator and opponent_server_handle.

reviews.coverage_gap_note: Full per-opponent Elo-gate promotion path is only exercised by the #[ignore]'d opponent_load_weights_changes_root_setup_output test, so this regression is not caught on CI.
